name: hexvero-monorepo
description: hexvero.dev — the first look at a binary or app bundle: static analysis with evidence, locally.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexvero/core -w @hexvero/mcp -w @hexvero/server -w hexvero && npm run build -w @hexvero/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp packages/server packages/cli && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run check:shape
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/build-examples.mjs && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.corpus: npm run build && node corpus/build.mjs --check && node corpus/gate.mjs
scripts.corpus:accept: npm run build && node corpus/observe-hexvero.mjs && node corpus/score.mjs corpus/results/hexvero.observations.json --markdown corpus/results/hexvero.md --json corpus/results/hexvero.json
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/release-verify.mjs && node scripts/smoke-tarballs.mjs
